integrity: Proof is self-contained. verify.py reproduces exact finite checks with standard-library Python; finite checks alone do not establish the unrestricted theorem. No independent verification claimed.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to parallel firing of a binary configuration with three occupied vertices on an oriented cycle, with ordinary unfiltered avalanche complexes; earlier adjacent and consecutive three-chip cases are acknowledged as known. Novelty remains subject to unindexed earlier equivalent results.
title: Complete three-chip avalanche homotopy classification on directed cycles
